value.text: I am planning a weekend in Lisbon. Name one neighbourhood to stay in.

Stay in **Alfama**, Lisbon's oldest neighbourhood. It has winding streets, fado music, and great viewpoints, and it's within easy reach of the main sights on foot or by tram. If you'd prefer somewhere more central with lots of restaurants and nightlife, Baixa-Chiado is a good alternative.
What is one dish I should try there?
Try **bacalhau à Brás**, a classic Lisbon dish of shredded salt cod, thin fried potatoes, eggs, and onions. For something sweeter, grab a **pastel de nata** afterward.
Summarise your two suggestions in one sentence.
